name: project-scaffold
description: Config-driven project scaffolding as composable copier recipes. 31 recipes covering git, CI, quality gates, release, docs, infrastructure, containers, and agentic tooling, with 13 profiles naming which recipes a shape renders and in what order. The project-scaffold skill runs the interview and renders a profile end to end; project-scaffold-update adopts a recipe, merges recipe changes into a rendered repository, and retrofits one that predates the tool.
